en.title: V-I-L-L-A
en.decryption: The 5 Sila are prohibitions against: Violence (Life), Larceny (Theft), Adultery (Sexual misconduct), Lying (False speech), and Intoxication.

fact.en: Mistaking Pancha Sila for the 'Pancha Mahavrata' of Jainism; while overlapping, Jain principles are far more ascetic and rigid.

fact.en: Confusing 'Pancha Sila' with the 'Pancha Sheel' treaty of 1954 (Nehru-Zhou Enlai) which is modern diplomatic history, not Ancient history.
